blurb: 1365 Church Street Vineyards is a working vineyard with 14.8 acres of vines, predominantly white grape varieties. Guests can enjoy wine tastings in a turn-of-the-century apple barn with views of the Annapolis Valley. The property features beautiful gardens with bicycles hidden throughout and offers tours of the winery and climate-controlled wine storage areas, subject to availability during peak farm times.
